annotation.title_clean: Missouri Revised Statutes Section 304.900 – Personal delivery devices, authority to operate
annotation.title_en: Missouri Revised Statutes Section 304.900 – Personal delivery devices, authority to operate
annotation.summary_en: Missouri statute (effective 28 Aug 2021, SB 176) authorizing personal delivery devices on sidewalks, crosswalks and roadways. It sets operating requirements, a $100,000 insurance minimum, lighting rules, a hazardous materials ban, limits on local regulation, and a ban on selling personally identifiable likenesses.
key_provisions_or_claims: Personal delivery devices may operate on sidewalks, crosswalks and roadways statewide and are not classed as motor vehicles.
Devices must have a unique ID, operator identification, a controlled-stop system, a 10 mph sidewalk speed limit, and must obey traffic signals.
Operators must carry at least $100,000 general liability insurance.
Operators may not sell personally identifiable likenesses; disclosure to law enforcement requires a subpoena.
Localities may regulate operation but not design, manufacture, or discriminatory taxation.
